source: Exact GT predictions measured AP50=1.0 on all55,616 exported frames. The normal Docker CPU verifier also measured missing=0, truncated=0 and GT=1 over2,475 hidden frames. See gt_reference_measurement.json and RESULTS.md; these are author checks, not formal GPU ALE validation.
note: Unrounded reward equals raw AP50; the engine serializes primary reward to two decimals and preserves reward_exact. Trained baselines never set the denominator or saturation threshold. Formal ALE lifecycle admission remains separate.
